brief: public String detect(InputStream stream) throws IOException{}
full_method_info:
/** * Detects the media type of the given document. The type detection is * based on the content of the given document stream. *

* If the document stream supports the * {@link InputStream#markSupported() mark feature}, then the stream is * marked and reset to the original position before this method returns. * Only a limited number of bytes are read from the stream. *

* The given document stream is not closed by this method. * * @param stream the document stream * @return detected media type * @throws IOException if the stream can not be read */ public String detect(InputStream stream) throws IOException { ParseContext context = new ParseContext(); return detect(stream, Metadata.newInstance(context)); }
